description: Treasury bill ladder calculator with an interactive timeline chart. Lays out how much goes in each same-term bill, how far apart to buy them, and the first and last dates. Shows simple interest only if a rate is given.

amount.description: Total dollars to split across the bills, from 0 to 1,000,000,000.

rate_pct.description: An annual interest rate the person chooses, in percent, from 0 to 25. Leave out to skip interest.

rungs.description: How many bills to stagger, a whole number no larger than the term in weeks (13 at most for 52-week bills).

start_date.description: The first purchase date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

term_weeks.description: Length of each bill in weeks: 4, 8, 13, 17, 26 or 52.

name: tbill_ladder
title: T-Bill Ladder Calculator
